title: I just had my ‘first’ mall dream
content: First thing I did when I woke up was Google the meaning and stumbled across this sub! In my dream I felt like I’d been there before, it was familiar? It was a positive dream, the mall had shops, mirrors, a fountain, and it had a good energy. I felt excited to be back and be able to go and have a look again but my dog woke me up. I don’t recall dreaming about it before but it really felt like I’d been there. Is it possible I’ve dreamt about it before but always forgotten?
